claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tangeritin is a polymethoxylated flavone with no potent annotated target; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no selective cytotoxicity, with any weak antiproliferative effect reflecting nonspecific flavonoid activity rather than a defined mechanism class.
